input.sha256_scope: No image input. Every case is a page size in PDF points plus scale and budget parameters written out in the capture tool; the expected file is both the input record and the expected record. Page sizes are recorded as exact f64 hex bits because a decimal round-trip is not an oracle.

upstream.capture_method: The pinned scale planner was imported and executed over eleven parameter cases plus five invalid inputs; scales are recorded as exact f64 bits. No PDF was opened and no renderer ran.

limitations: The planner only: pdfium rendering itself stays behind the five-part entry gate in docs/ADR_DOCIO_DEC_001_PDF_AND_OFFICE.md, and no page is rasterized by this fixture.
Upstream's PDFReaderBackend defaults max_pixels=None, which bypasses the budget entirely; this port makes the budget mandatory and records the divergence deliberately.
The ResourceLimit error reports the pixel count at minimum scale, the figure upstream's PDFRenderSizeError carries; the per-axis extents in that error are not preserved.
Non-finite inputs cannot be expressed by the upstream capture (Python raises before them); the Rust refusals for NaN and infinity are asserted directly rather than captured.
